name: Artisan Fist
description: Strike with the fist the school's way with a core of made qi at the knuckles.

name: Artisan Step
description: Make the school's small footing in the air and stride on it.

name: Artisan Salve
description: Make the school's soothing salve of qi and lay it on an ally's wound.

name: Artisan Chain
description: Make the school's fine chain and wind it about a foe's limbs.

name: Artisan Edge
description: Make a clean cutting edge in the school's way and draw it through the foe.

name: Artisan Ward
description: Make the school's ward of layered plates before the user.

name: Artisan Aegis
description: Make the school's bastion about the user and allies that turns blows and steadies their stance.

name: Artisan Volley
description: Make a rank of the school's bolts and loose them across the foes together.

name: Artisan Masterwork
description: Make a masterwork of qi above the foe and bring it down in the school's finest blow.

name: Artisan Opus
description: The school's closing move that makes one finished opus of qi whose weight and reach follow the reserve poured in.

name: Genesis Fist
description: Strike with a fist in which the school's first force is born at the knuckles.

name: Genesis Step
description: Bring ground out of nothing beneath the foot and stride across it.

name: Genesis Mend
description: Bring whole flesh out of nothing over an ally's wound as if it had never opened.

name: Genesis Bind
description: Bring bands of the school's first force into being about a foe.

name: Genesis Bolt
description: Bring a bolt of the school's first force into being and loose it at once.

name: Genesis Ward
description: Bring a ward into being before the user and let it stand as if always there.

name: Genesis Lance
description: Bring a lance into being in the foe's guard and drive it through.

name: Genesis Renewal
description: Bring breath back into a fallen ally whose heart has just stopped and set it beating.

name: Genesis Burst
description: Bring a burst of first force into being at the heart of the foes and loose it outward.

name: Genesis Prime
description: The school's closing move that brings a prime force into being whose reach and weight follow the core's reserve.

name: Golem Fist
description: Make a small golem fist of qi that strikes in step with the user's own.

name: Golem Step
description: Make a golem beneath the feet that bears the user across a short distance.

name: Golem Guard
description: Make a small golem that stands before the user and takes the blow.

name: Golem Bind
description: Make golem arms that rise from the ground and clasp a foe's legs.

name: Golem Smash
description: Make a golem of qi that swings a great arm at the foe.

name: Golem Mend
description: Make a gentle golem that kneels by an ally and closes their wounds with its hands.

name: Golem Aid
description: Make a golem that stands at an ally's shoulder and lends them its strength.

name: Golem Shoulder
description: Make a line of golems shoulder to shoulder that stops a charge.

name: Golem Charge
description: Make a pack of golems that rush the foes and trample all in their course.

name: Golem Titan
description: Make a titan of qi that rises over the field and brings its fist down on one foe.

name: Golem Host
description: The school's closing move that makes a host of golems whose number and might follow the reserve poured in.

name: Primeval Fist
description: Strike with a fist formed of the first matter as heavy as new stone.

name: Primeval Step
description: Form the first matter beneath the foot and stride out upon it.

name: Primeval Gift
description: Form the first matter into fresh vigor and give it to an ally to drink.

name: Primeval Bind
description: Form the first matter about a foe's limbs and let it set hard.

name: Primeval Salve
description: Form the first matter into flesh and lay it on an ally's wound until it is whole.

name: Primeval Ward
description: Form a ward of the first matter before the user to meet a heavy blow.

name: Primeval Javelin
description: Form a lance of the first matter and drive it through the foe's guard.

name: Primeval Veil
description: Form a veil of the first matter about the user that lets lesser blows fade away.

name: Primeval Surge
description: Form a surge of the first matter that spreads over the field and crushes what it meets.

name: Primeval Making
description: The school's closing move that forms the first matter over the field with a weight set by the core's reserve.
